messages:
Alyssa: heads-up: planning a config-only rollout in the 00:30-01:30 UTC quiet window. Changes: default tail timeout 180 -> 120s, tenant-weight floor to prevent starvation, routing hint to prefer lower-cost region subset, batching tiny-window 8 -> 6ms. No model swaps, just routing/limits/batching
Jordan: got it. Which service and config key?
Alyssa: inference-router (orbit). config key cfg.orbit.timeout-throttle and cfg.orbit.batch-window for batching. No binary changes.
deploy-bot: deploy request from @Alyssa received. Dry-run OK. Canary plan: staging -> 2% prod -> 10% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Auto checks: p95/p99, 5xx rate, kv-cache-hit%, batch-size distribution. Rollout id cfg-1713456789.
Samir: suggestion: last time a timeout reduction caused p99 tail spikes for long seqs. Propose 2% canary initially (not 5%) and longer first observation (10m) to watch p99.
Maggie: +1. Also routing to cheap-region will change batching dynamics for some tenants — propose tenant-weight-floor=0.05 so small tenants don't get starved into tiny batches.
Alyssa: switching to 2% canary + 10m window, then 10% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Adding tenant-weight-floor=0.05. Keeping model pins unchanged.
Jordan: what metrics are hard gates? p95, p99, 5xx, kv-hit delta >5pp, mean batch size drop >15%?
Samir: add tail-latency slope: if p99 > baseline +10% for 3 consecutive minutes -> auto-pause. infra-error-rate >0.5% -> pause.
deploy-bot: rollout cfg-1713456789 started at canary 2%. Hooks: traces, per-model token breakdown, cost-delta estimate. Rollback alias /deploy rollback cfg-1713456789 registered.
Maggie: can we pin routing for priority tenants to stable-region during canary so they stay on warm hosts?
Alyssa: yes, will apply routing override: priority-tenants -> stable-region pin for the canary window.
Jordan: small note: batching-window override requires runtime flag enable-batching-window-override=true in the runtime config.
Alyssa: added and verified on staging.
Samir: staging logs look OK: slightly more RPC fanout to cold hosts but p99 within baseline. batch-size median down ~5%, mean flat. kv-cache-hit unchanged.
Maggie: cost tool: slight per-token increase for micro-tenants but overall cost decreases due to cheap-region routing. Adding that to release notes.
Alyssa: moving to canary now. I will post snapshots at +5m and +10m.
deploy-bot: canary snapshot @+5m: p95 stable, p99 +3%, errors +0.02pp, kv-cache-hit -0.4pp. No gates tripped.
Alyssa: good. schedule bump to 10% at +10m.
Jordan: tag rollout with `quiet-window` and `safety-fence:v1` please so dashboards filter correctly.
Alyssa: tags applied.
deploy-bot: staging -> scheduling 10% bump.
Samir: watching p99. If it hits +10% we auto-pause. Also watch mean batch-size; if it drops >20% we should revert batching change.
Maggie: updating internal release note: ["timeout 180->120s","routing preference to cheap-region subset","tenant-weight-floor=0.05","batch-window 8->6ms","priority-tenants pinned to stable-region during canary"]
Alyssa: after 20m at 10%: p95 OK, p99 +6% (below threshold), errors +0.1pp, kv-hit -0.9pp. Proceeding per plan.
deploy-bot: bumping to 50% now.
Jordan: wait  I'm seeing a concentrated 5xx spike on cheap-region-hostpool-7. Hold bump for 2m.
Alyssa: pausing ramp immediately. Paused: reason spike in 5xx on cheap-region-hostpool-7. Can we route around that pool and re-evaluate?
Samir: recommend drain hostpool-7, reassign its share to other pools, and change next step to 20% (not 50%). Also consider retracting batching-window tweak for this rollout to simplify variables.
Maggie: concur. Separate the batching-window change into a follow-up so we only roll timeouts + routing + weight-floor now.
Alyssa: plan accepted: (1) revert batch-window in staged rollout to 8ms, (2) drain hostpool-7 (Samir), (3) reroute traffic off pool-7, (4) resume at 20% with manual approval required before 50%.
deploy-bot: executing: revert cfg.orbit.batch-window to 8ms in staged config, reroute traffic off hostpool-7, updated rollout plan. Rollout paused.
Jordan: documenting decision in change ticket and release notes. Scheduling follow-up batching-only change next quiet window.
Samir: started drain of hostpool-7. ETA ~6m.
deploy-bot: action completed: hostpool-7 drained. Rollout ready to resume at 20% after stability window.
Maggie: updated internal release notes and notified support/customer-success that priority-tenants were pinned during the canary.
Alyssa: resuming ramp to 20% now. Will monitor p99/5xx/kv-hit/cost. Manual approval required before any 50% bump.
deploy-bot: resumed rollout: stage=20%. Auto-pause gates active.
Jordan: thanks everyone. Good call separating the batching change.
Alyssa: will open a follow-up PR with a dedicated perf run for batching-only change in next quiet window. Closing this coordination thread; will post follow-up if anything else occurs.
deploy-bot: rollout cfg-1713456789 at 20%. Thread will be archived when rollout completes or is fully rolled back.
